topic_detail: A static image of his matriculation certificate (Israeli school-leaving certificate) with a Q&A sticker 'Do you have a matriculation certificate?' and a text claim that grades have no link to success in life.
audience: school students and parents, his followers
caption_vs_video_note: Caption extends the on-image claim: success comes from courage, not memorising irrelevant material; asks to share with students; notes it was meant for the next day's Q&A but 'justifies its own post'.

opening.first_frame: A scan of a Hebrew school certificate 'תעודת בגרות' with a dark Instagram question-sticker 'שאלות תשובות / תרביצו' over it and a white text box below.
opening.s0_1: Static; the sticker question 'יש לך תעודת בגרות?' and the text box are already on screen.
opening.s1_3: No change; very slight image drift at the end (an animated zoom or none is not visible).
opening.visual_hook: A scan of his actual certificate with seven subject grades (all in the 70s and 80s) under an Instagram question sticker.
opening.text_hook: יש לך תעודת בגרות? / תלמידים יקרים, אין קשר בין ציונים טובים להצלחה בחיים משקרים לכם, ושיקרו גם לי.
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes (a question and a direct claim)
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: yes (the grades on the certificate: 74, 86, 73 and similar)

visual.subject_placement: A flat document filling the frame; the sticker at the top and a white caption box at the bottom.
visual.setting: A scanned yellowed certificate with a decorative border.
visual.color_contrast: Black text on a cream page; a dark sticker header; red and black text on white.
visual.supporting_footage: The certificate image and an Instagram Q&A sticker.
visual.faces_blurred: n/a (no people; the certificate year is masked with a black box)
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is the same frame
visual.ui_interference: Key text sits in the lower 35% (the white text box at about 75-90% of the frame height) and the sticker at 8-25%; the sticker is in the top zone only partly.

editing.edit_function: None: a single static image. The detector reports one cut at 3.0 s which is the end of the clip.
editing.ending: The image holds to 3.0 s and stops; no speech, no end card.
editing.loop: yes: at 3 s a looping Reel starts the same static frame again, so the text is read repeatedly (inferred from the length)
editing.rewatch_reasons: interpretation: three seconds is too short to read all text once and it likely replays automatically.

sound.delivery: Silent: all loudness values are -90 dB.

text.colour_coding: Black text with a red emphasis phrase ('אין קשר בין ציונים טובים להצלחה בחיים').
text.placement: A white box at the bottom third; a question sticker at the top.
text.style: Bold black sans-serif on a white rounded box, red emphasis; the sticker is dark with white text.
text.density_and_read_time: About 14 words in the box plus the 6-word sticker in 3 s: dense for the duration.
text.language: Direct address ('תלמידים יקרים'), a personal confession ('ושיקרו גם לי').
text.caption_structure: Several lines: the claim, a cause (courage over memorising), 'שתפו עם כמה שיותר תלמידים 🙏' and a note on the post's origin.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew punctuation correct; the sticker's emoji is placed to the left of 'תרביצו'.

story.setup: A story-question 'do you have a matriculation certificate?'
story.payoff: The certificate shows ordinary grades and the claim that grades do not matter.
story.payoff_delivered: yes: the claim is stated; no elaboration
friction_points: t=0-3 s: more text than can be read in 3 s (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Approximate hand count over 45 sampled comments. Comments tell personal school stories ('הייתי עם קשיי למידה'), agree ('שום דבר שם לא תרם לי לחיים') and criticise ('תלוי מה המטרות שלך', a doctor example); the top comments (52 and 39 likes) add nuance: no correlation but do not give up in advance, and 'what is success' is subjective. Not representative of 97 comments.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: A heart emoji, a clapping emoji and a one-word spelling correction.

conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the share request targets students

rights_and_privacy: Own document with the year masked by a black box; an Instagram sticker UI; no third-party film; no people.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a concrete personal artefact (his own certificate) answering a direct question, a provocative claim and a shareable message for students; the Reel is 3 s long so it can loop.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: no voice or motion and a short duration; the text is hard to read in one pass.

standout_moments.what: The real certificate with its grades in view as visual proof under a Q&A sticker.
